mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_password_setup_deliveries (caller_client_id, request_id, identity_id, status, completed_at) VALUES (#{row.callerClientId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.identityId}, 'PASSWORD_READY', #{row.completedAt})

INSERT INTO iam_password_setup_deliveries (caller_client_id, request_id, identity_id, status, challenge_id, challenge_expires_at) VALUES (#{row.callerClientId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.identityId}, 'PENDING', #{row.challengeId}, #{row.challengeExpiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (caller_client_id, request_id) DO UPDATE SET challenge_id = EXCLUDED.challenge_id, challenge_expires_at = EXCLUDED.challenge_expires_at WHERE iam_password_setup_deliveries.identity_id = EXCLUDED.identity_id AND iam_password_setup_deliveries.status = 'PENDING'
